title: Ukraine war latest: Russia threatens all of Europe, Macron tells France; White House defends Musk's lack of a suit
description: French President Emmanuel Macron has told his country Russia threatens all of Europe, in a televised speech about Ukraine and security. Earlier, the US cut off intelligence sharing with Ukraine, which led to talk of new meetings. Listen to the latest episode of The World below.

title: Canada could take part Ukraine peacekeeping, Bill Blair says
description: Canada is willing to participate in an as-yet undefined peacekeeping operation in Ukraine if a deal to stop the fighting with Russia is reached, Defence Minister Bill Blair said Wednesday.

title: Pause in U.S. intelligence help for Ukraine will hurt but not cripple Kyiv's war effort, ex-officials say
description: President Trump’s decision to pause intelligence assistance to Ukraine will hamper the country’s war effort but will not cripple Kyiv’s fight against Russia.

title: NATO armies unprepared for drone wars
description: NATO armed forces are not ready for a modern drone war, the military commander in charge of Ukraine’s unmanned systems warned, three years into a conflict with Russia in which both sides are pushing for a technological edge.

title: US, Ukraine Discuss Location And Date For Negotiations With Russia Days After Trump-Zelenskyy Spat
description: The United States and Ukraine have discussed date and location for negotiations with Russia. This comes days after Trump and Zelenskyy engaged in ugly spat at Oval Office.

title: Kremlin says a 2022 Ukrainian decree bans Zelensky from talks with Putin
description: Russia is asking how Ukraine could attend potential talks on ending their three-year war when a Ukrainian decree rules out negotiations with President Vladimir Putin.

title: US stops sharing intelligence on Russia with Ukraine
description: US no longer providing information about targets in Russia, in latest blow after halting military aid

title: War latest: Ukraine and US agree to meet, Zelenskyy aide says - after US stopped intelligence sharing
description: Zelenskyy's top aide says American and Ukrainian teams have agreed to meet again in the near future. Earlier, the US cut off intelligence sharing with Ukraine. Elsewhere, a British man accused of fighting for Ukraine has been jailed in Russia. Listen to The World podcast as you scroll.
